open_issues.text: attestation.build rejects a tag that differs from v<top CHANGELOG version> (RELEASE_VERSION_MISMATCH), so bundle calls it without a tag at ref HEAD. The attestation's umbrella.tag is therefore v<CHANGELOG version>, while compat.json umbrella.tag and the archive name use the --tag label. The attestation reads HEAD, so uncommitted changes are not reflected in it, while compat.json and the schema package come from the worktree.

open_issues.text: The attestation needs the module that holds configs/publication-versions.json as package_root. bundle auto-detects it as the only packages/*/configs/publication-versions.json (none or several gives no package_root), so no module id is hardcoded. Without that the real hub failed with git show HEAD:configs/publication-versions.json.

open_issues.text: Design choices where the sketch was silent: the contract path in compat.json is hub-relative (packages/<id>/<path>); the schema key is `schema` as in the knowledge text; bridges are read from bridges/*/unit.json directly, not via SKM_UNITS_PATH; the archive holds all regular files under schemas/ (examples included) except __pycache__, .git, node_modules and .pyc, with index.json first and only *.schema.json files indexed; the tar uses GNU format with mode 0644 for all members; the tag must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]*$.

summary: Added aicore.release.bundle and the CLI group `aicore release bundle --root --tag --out`. It writes compat.json (compat-manifest/v1 from unit.json of packages/* and bridges/*), a deterministic schemas-<tag>.tar.gz with index.json {id,version,path,sha256}, release-attestation.json (attestation.build at ref HEAD; the tag is only a label) and SHA256SUMS. A non-empty --out gives OUT_NOT_EMPTY (exit 2); a bad tag gives TAG_INVALID (exit 2). Everything is built in memory and written to --out only after all steps succeed. New contract packages/aicore/schemas/compat-manifest/v1 (schema, 2 valid and 4 invalid examples), listed in aicore unit.json provides.contracts. The `release` alias in configs/umbrella.json now routes `bundle` to aicore; other release words stay with skiller. Added tests test_bundle.py (10 tests) and TestReleaseBundleRoute (2 tests). Golden help cases recaptured for the changed alias description. Both CHANGELOGs updated. Narrow tests run and green: aicore tests.release.test_bundle, tests.test_contracts, tests.test_architecture; scripts/test-umbrella.py (57); golden.py check; public-hygiene; ecosystem-units.py check; aicore schema compat --base origin/ecosystem-split (0 errors). Manual V2-equivalent run of the real hub: two runs are byte-identical for tar.gz and compat.json, and sha256sum -c passes.
